text_to_video_no_image.notes: The 12-second maximum applies to no-image T2V only. It must not be propagated to image-conditioned modes.

single_image_to_video.notes: Do not infer 12 seconds from the no-image T2V domain.

tested_request_controls.generate_audio_omitted: one E2E observation with real AAC stereo audio

standard_probe_observation.request: text only, --ratio 16:9 --dur 5, no explicit audio/resolution/duration field

epistemic_limits: No-image T2V 12-second maximum is a modality-bounded control-plane condition, not an all-modalities model property.
I2V maximum duration remains unknown beyond the 5-second E2E domain.
Pro 250528 is now also E2E for single-image I2V; 1.5 Pro is not the only executable I2V route.
Do not generalize the 720p/108900-token observation into a universal cost/default rule.
production_notes: Use generate_audio=false explicitly when silence is required; omission produced audio in the controlled baseline.
Current hard single-image I2V routes include both 1.5 Pro 251215 and 1.0 Pro 250528.
Treat duration as exact_model × modality; never copy the no-image 12-second boundary into I2V without evidence.
